extension.description: Syntax highlighting, sorting, and alignment for Go struct field tags.
config.title: Go Struct Tags Manager
config.autoSortOnSave.description: Automatically sort struct field tags on file save.
config.sortMode.description: How to determine the canonical tag key order when sorting.
config.sortMode.smart: Keys are ranked by frequency in the struct, then by width. Frequent short tags come first; long or rare ones go last.
config.sortMode.firstField: Order is derived from the first struct field — keys that appear there come first, the rest follow in the order they are first encountered.
config.sortMode.alphabetical: All keys are sorted alphabetically (after applying sortPriority).
config.alignColumnThreshold.description: Minimum fraction of fields in an alignment group (0–1) for a tag to get a dedicated column. Tags below the threshold are appended without padding. Default: 0.5.
config.sortPriority.description: Tag keys that are always placed first, in the specified order, regardless of sortMode. Example: ["json", "yaml"].
config.autoAlignOnSave.description: Automatically align struct field tags on file save.
config.colors.key.description: Override color for tag keys (e.g. json, yaml). Leave empty to use theme color.
config.colors.value.description: Override color for tag values. Leave empty to use theme color.
config.colors.option.description: Override color for tag options (after =). Leave empty to use theme color.
config.colors.separator.description: Override color for tag separators (,). Leave empty to use theme color.
